intro: Tell us what you are building and we will put the right engineer on it. Enquiries are answered within one working day, Ho Chi Minh City time.

offices.name: Export desk
lines: Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

routes.name: Request a quotation
routes.blurb: Send a drawing, a section or a bill of quantities. We come back with tonnage, finish options, lead time and FOB pricing.
routes.intro: The more of the technical section you can fill in, the closer the first quotation will be. If you only have a sketch, send it anyway and leave the rest blank.

fields.hint: PDF, DWG, STEP or a photograph of a sketch. Up to 20 MB.

routes.name: Order finish samples
routes.blurb: Physical swatches of any finish in the Colors section, cut on the profile you intend to use. Sent free within ASEAN, at cost elsewhere.
routes.intro: A colour on a screen is not a colour. Tell us which finishes and we will cut them on a real section rather than sending a paper chip.

fields.hint: Leave blank for a flat sample bar

routes.name: Technical assistance
routes.blurb: Die design, thermal performance, structural sizing, coating specification. Answered by the engineer who works on that line, not by a call centre.
routes.intro: Questions go to the group that owns them: extrusion and dies, finishing chemistry, or facade engineering. Say which and it gets there faster.

routes.name: Become a distributor
routes.blurb: We appoint one distributor per territory and back them with stock, samples and technical support rather than only a price list.
routes.intro: Exclusivity works both ways. We will ask about your warehouse, your fabricator base and what you already carry, because a territory only supports one of these relationships.

consent: I authorise Böss Group to contact me about this enquiry and about related products and services.
